Mteja kuingia kwenye chumba kilichosafishwa nusu ni kosa linaloharibu sifa ya hoteli yako mara moja.

Hakikisha kila asubuhi msimamizi wa usafi anakagua mambo makuu matano: usafi wa bafu, taulo mpya, viyoyozi vinavyofanya kazi, taa, na harufu ya chumba kabla ya kubadili hali ya chumba kuwa Tayari.

Operra inasaidia timu yako ya usafi kutoa taarifa za vyumba vilivyo tayari papo hapo bila kupiga simu mapokezi.

headline: Regional guests expect unified hotel billing
body: Modern East African travelers expect food, drinks, and room costs on one accurate folio at checkout. Integrated operations keep transactions clear.
caption:
Modern travelers across East Africa move easily between the restaurant, bar, and front desk. They expect every expense on one clear bill at checkout.

When F&B systems are separated from room management, paper dockets get lost and manual entries delay checkouts. Unifying front desk, POS, and housekeeping keeps every transaction clear across your property.
